package.name: cnav_ros
package.description: ROS 1 wrapper for the CNN-SAC c-space (cost-ray) navigation policy trained in DRL-robot-navigation/SAC. Rebuilds the training observation (36 x nz cost rays + distance/heading) from live LaserScan + Odometry and publishes velocity commands, without needing Gazebo or the C++ c_space_mapper node.
